verdict.rationale: Carta's API platform does expose structured data (cap tables, stakeholders, grants, valuations) via REST endpoints, which offers some data access/portability, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature in open formats, and independent reports directly contradict the 'leave' part of the story — founders describe deliberately obstructed cancellation, migration difficulty, and being 'trapped' when trying to move to a competitor. Missing for 10: evidence of a full open-format data export/download feature, and any confirmation that customers can smoothly migrate their full cap table data elsewhere.
